description: Maps a Meta (Facebook/Instagram) Lead Ads form submission for the insurance agent recruiting funnel onto this system's internal candidate profile fields. GHL's native Facebook integration auto-creates the contact; this mapping governs how that contact is tagged and routed once ingested.
compliance_note: No guaranteed-earnings language may appear on the source ad creative or lead form per insurance_pack.json compliance_review_controls; this mapping does not enforce that (ad copy review is a human compliance step), it only ingests whatever the form collects.
